stem: A breeding population unexpectedly produces intersex flowers after a major environmental stress event. What is the strongest interpretation?
choices: The phenotype proves every plant carries the same deterministic gene
Record genotype, timing and stress context, then separate environmental induction from repeatable genetic susceptibility through further testing
The event has no breeding relevance
rationale: Sex-expression instability can involve genotype and environment; repeatable testing is needed before assigning genetic liability.
